items.titleZh: Oasis Miracle 四室双层住宅
items.loc: Oasis Miracle, 2nd Street, Ibex Hill, Lusaka
items.descZh:
Oasis Miracle 社区内的四室双层住宅，售价 K 3,500,000。四间卧室中，两间为带独立卫浴的套房，一间位于楼上，一间位于楼下，兼顾家庭成员与访客使用。

开放式厨房与客厅相连，并配有阳台和储藏室。社区提供 24 小时安保、游泳池和商业配套，房屋另配太阳能板。
items.descEn:
A four-bedroom double-storey home in the Oasis Miracle community, offered at K 3,500,000. Two bedrooms are self-contained ensuites, with one upstairs and one downstairs, providing a practical arrangement for family members and guests.

The home features an open-plan kitchen and living area, a balcony and a pantry. Community amenities include 24/7 security, a swimming pool and a commercial building. A solar panel is also included.

items.descZh: Kalundu（Off Great East Road）位于 2,100㎡ 地块上的六室开放式豪宅，450㎡ 居住空间。主卧带男女独立卫浴、步入式衣帽间、电热毛巾架；主厨厨房配花岗岩台面、中岛与早餐区；大开间客厅与餐厅全屋空调；私家泳池与户外娱乐区。临近 LICS、Manda Hill、East Park Mall 与 Arcades，安静且安保完善。适合行政自住或高端投资。
items.descEn: A premium 6-bedroom open-plan residence on a 2,100 sqm plot with 450 sqm of living space in Kalundu, off Great East Road. Master suite with his & hers bathrooms, walk-in closet and heated towel rail; chef's kitchen with granite countertops, island and breakfast nook; fully air-conditioned open-plan living and dining; private swimming pool and entertainment area. In a quiet, secure neighbourhood close to LICS, Manda Hill, East Park Mall and Arcades. Ideal for executive living or a premium investment.
